reference_sql:
WITH first_pay AS (  -- one row per user with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT su.user_id, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM subscriptions su
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
  GROUP BY su.user_id
)
SELECT g.country_code,
       COUNT(*) AS paying_users,
       ROUND(AVG(CAST(f.first_paid_at AS DATE) - CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE)), 1) AS avg_days_to_pay,
       MAX(CAST(f.first_paid_at AS DATE) - CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE)) AS max_days_to_pay
FROM signups g
JOIN first_pay f ON f.user_id = g.user_id
WHERE g.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND g.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY g.country_code
ORDER BY g.country_code

       MAX(date_diff('day', CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE), CAST(f.first_paid_at AS DATE))) AS max_days_to_pay
FROM signups AS g
JOIN (
  -- one row per user with a payment that was not refunded
  SELECT su.user_id, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM subscriptions su
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
  WHERE p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY su.user_id
) AS f ON f.user_id = g.user_id
WHERE CAST(g.signup_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH q3_signups AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in July to September 2025
  SELECT user_id, country_code, CAST(signup_ts AS DATE) AS signup_day
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
),
pay_days AS (  -- one row per payment of those users that was not refunded
  SELECT q.user_id, q.country_code, CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE) - q.signup_day AS days_to_pay
  FROM q3_signups q
  JOIN subscriptions su ON su.user_id = q.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = su.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
),
first_days AS (  -- one row per paying user
  SELECT user_id, country_code, MIN(days_to_pay) AS days_to_pay
  FROM pay_days
  GROUP BY user_id, country_code
)
SELECT country_code, COUNT(user_id) AS paying_users, ROUND(AVG(days_to_pay), 1) AS avg_days_to_pay, MAX(days_to_pay) AS max_days_to_pay
FROM first_days
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC

solver.query:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT user_id, country_code, signup_ts FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-01 00:00:00+00'
), f AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE p.refunded = false
  GROUP BY s.user_id
), x AS (
  SELECT u.country_code,
         date_diff('day', CAST(u.signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE), CAST(f.first_paid AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE)) AS days
  FROM u JOIN f ON f.user_id = u.user_id
)
SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS paying_users, ROUND(AVG(days::DOUBLE), 1) AS avg_days_to_pay, MAX(days) AS max_days_to_pay
FROM x
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC
